messages.text:
On it. Two things so I can place it well:

1. How long should the staff meeting be — 30 min, or an hour?
2. Looking at next week, your only genuinely free gaps are short: Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30 (Thu and Fri are booked end to end). If you want a full hour, I'd have to use a Lunch block or push something — tell me if that's allowed, otherwise I'll aim for a 30-minute slot.

Meanwhile I'm asking the TAs for their availability in the group thread.

Thirty minutes is plenty for a staff meeting. Don't use a Lunch block and don't push anything — take one of the free half-hour gaps, whichever suits the TAs best. If two of them work equally well, I'd slightly prefer Monday 10:00–10:30, but I'll take what the TAs can make.

Noted: 30 minutes, no lunch block, nothing pushed. Heads-up though — Monday 10:00–10:30, your slight preference, is the one gap that's out: John is in CSE455 office hours until 10:30 and Hana has the CSE444 lecture then. What's still open for everyone who has reported (you, John, Hana, Priya, Diego) is Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Sarah hasn't reported yet — as soon as she does, I'll take the earliest of those that works for her and confirm.
Fine — go with the earliest of those three that works for Sarah, and confirm once she's in. No need to check back with me unless something else conflicts.

Update: next week's **CSE455 staff meeting is booked — Tuesday 24 Nov 2026, 15:00–15:30** (you + Professor Alvarez, John, Priya, Diego, Hana). It's the earliest slot everyone had free; I've put it in your calendar and logged it. Your Tuesday after it is unchanged: office hours 15:30–16:20, quiz section 16:20–17:00.

FYI: the group thread fixed next week's CSE455 staff meeting — **Tue 24 Nov 2026, 15:00–15:30** (Alvarez, Sarah, Priya, Diego, Hana). It fits your Tuesday (CSE452 lab focus ends 15:00, Advisor 1:1 starts 15:30), so I booked it in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` and logged it as `BOOKED`. Say the word if you'd rather not take it and I'll tell them.
Thanks, that works. Tuesday is full but 15:00 straight after the CSE452 lecture is fine, and I'll go right into office hours at 15:30. Nothing else to change on my side.

Done, Professor — **CSE455 staff meeting: Tue 24 Nov 2026, 15:00–15:30**. Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana are all free then, and each of them has now confirmed and blocked it in their own calendar.

Your calendar is updated: `15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` sits between Grant writing and the Research meeting, and the log line `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)` is in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`. No lunch block used and nothing moved. I'll tell you if any of the TAs reports a conflict.
That slot works for me — thanks for checking. Keep it booked.
Perfect, thank you. Tuesday 15:00–15:30 it is — that's all I needed.
Kept — Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30 stays booked and logged.

Noted — nothing changed on your side; the calendar and the log now reflect exactly that (CSE452 lecture 13:40–15:00 → CSE455 staff meeting 15:00–15:30 → office hours 15:30–16:20).

I'm ready whenever you want to start: calendar and messages are running, and if you'd like, I can set up my own Telegram / WhatsApp / MAX (and Messenger / Instagram) — each just needs a separate account with its own phone number that you create in the app, then you scan my QR code.

Heads up: next week's **CSE455 staff meeting is fixed — Tue 24 Nov 2026, 15:00–15:30** (Prof. Alvarez, Sarah, John, Priya, Hana and you). It went into your calendar between Study group (ends 15:00) and Seminar (starts 15:30), and the log line is `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff (Prof. Alvarez, Sarah, John, Priya, Hana)`. Everyone on the thread confirmed and booked on their side. I've set a reminder for 14:45 that Tuesday. Anything to change, tell me.
No need for those for now — this chat and email are enough for me. Let's leave the messenger accounts for later; I'll let you know if that changes.
Thanks — that slot is clear on my side: straight after study group, right before the seminar. Nothing to change. The 14:45 reminder is enough.

Understood — no messenger accounts for now, and I won't bring it up again unless you do.

One thing: I don't have an e-mail account yet (no mailbox of my own). If you meant e-mail as a way to reach you, say the word and I'll create one in my own browser and keep the password and codes in my password store — otherwise I'll just use this chat.
No, don't create a mailbox — just use this chat, that's all I need. I meant e-mail as something I already have; you don't need one of your own.
Got it — no mailbox, this chat only. I'm here when you need me.
